extracted.intended_audience: Department of Intellectual Property staff, Ministry of Commerce policymakers, IT implementers, and patent applicants/stakeholders in Thailand
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Department of Intellectual Property (Thailand) strategic goals, organizational structure, automation/online-service requirements, and the statistical metrics tracked for patent and petty-patent work. Useful for planning, evaluating, or implementing patent office processes and IT systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision: Achieving Excellency in Intellectual Property Protection
rubrics_metrics.description: The DIP's stated vision is 'Achieving Excellency in Intellectual Property Protection'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the high-level objective guiding missions and strategies of the office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: Providing efficient protection of IP
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the DIP missions: 'Providing efficient protection of IP.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies targets/criteria around timeliness, effectiveness, and administrative efficiency of IP protection processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: Safeguarding IP rights in a fair manner
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the DIP missions: 'Safeguarding IP rights in a fair manner.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes impartiality, due process, and equitable enforcement as evaluative criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: Promotion of creation and commercial exploitation of IP
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the DIP missions: 'Promotion creation and commercial exploitation of IP.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates measures of success should include facilitation of commercialization and support for creators/innovators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: Strengthening knowledge and understanding related to IP
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the DIP missions: 'Strengthening knowledge and understanding related to IP.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggests education, outreach, and training activities as part of the office's remit and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy: Developing systems for protection of IP rights at domestic and international levels
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategy item: 'Developing systems for the protection of IP rights at domestic and international levels.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers building processes/systems that meet both national needs and international obligations (e.g., filings, data exchange).

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy: Suppressing IP infringement and creating fairness and disciplines in trade
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategy item: 'Suppressing IP infringement and creating fairness as well as disciplines in trade.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance can be judged by enforcement actions, reduction in infringement incidents, and improved market fairness.

rubrics_metrics.name: IP categories managed by DIP
rubrics_metrics.description: List of IP types under DIP: Industrial Design, Invention, Patent, Computer Program, Traditional Knowledge, Petty Patent, Integrated Circuit layout-design, Goods Mark, Copyright, Neighboring Rights, Trade Secrets, Trademarks, Geographical Indication, Service Mark, Collective Mark, Certification Mark, Optical Disc Production, Protection of new varieties of plant Act (agriculture/cooperatives).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the scope of rights the office administers and the case types systems/processes must support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent application bibliographic data fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Core application/publication fields shown: 'Application number and date', 'Priority data', 'Inventor', 'Agent', 'Title', 'Publication number and date', 'IPC', 'Applicant', 'Abstract', 'Drawing'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the minimum bibliographic/metadata elements the office records and publishes for patent applications; systems and forms must capture/store them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent system functional capabilities (current)
rubrics_metrics.description: Functional capabilities listed for the Patent System: 'Internal & Internet Application', 'Full Functions for Administration', 'Online Examination & Searching', 'Logo searches for visual analysis'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specify must-have features for the patent IT system—support for both internal workflows and internet-facing services, administrative functions, electronic examination tools, and visual/logo search capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online services offered
rubrics_metrics.description: Online/Internet services enumerated: 'Patent Application system', 'Trademark Application & Search System', 'Geographical Indication search system', 'Patent Search System', 'Copyright Search System', 'DIP Databases', 'DIP Website (www.ipthailand.org)', 'Intellectual Property Training Center'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the range of public-facing services the office provides and which systems need to be available online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Future automation requirements / plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Planned automation items: 'Paperless on Trademark System (2012-2013)', 'Patent Automation System (2012-2013)', 'Paperless on Copyright System (2012-2013)'; and cross-cutting items: '* e–Signature will apply for all systems', '* Online filing Patent and Trademark applications', '* Scan all applications store in Database', '* Fully automate systems for application processing'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are roadmap requirements for transitioning to e-filing, paperless operations, e-signature, document imaging and end-to-end automation of application workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics metric: Number of Patent Applications (by year/type/origin)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tracked metric: 'Number of Patent Application' with breakdown fields: Unit: Number; categories: Patent, Design, Invention; and sub-breakdowns by Year, Total, Thai, Foreigner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporting/monitoring requirement—systems must support collecting and reporting counts by year, IP type, and applicant origin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics metric: Number of Granted Patents (by year/type/origin)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tracked metric: 'Number of Granted Patent' with breakdowns: Unit: Number; categories include Design and Invention; fields: Year, Total, Thai, Foreigner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance metric representing grant outputs; used for annual reporting and resource planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics metric: Petty Patent Applications and Registrations
rubrics_metrics.description: Tracked metric table: 'Statistics of Petty Patent Application and Granted' showing numbers for Application and Registration with columns: Total, Thai, Foreigner, by year and totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates monitoring of petty-patent workflow volumes separate from regular patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational staffing and examiner allocation
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization chart details: Director of Patent Office; specialist groups (e.g., Engineering, Physics, Petrochemicals, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Electrical); counts such as Patent Examiner = 22, Assistant Patent Examiner = 9, Petty Patent examiner = 6, Assistant Petty Patent Examiner = 4, Opposition Patent Examiner = 1; total staff numbers and group-level roles (Patent administration, Patent certificate & Controlling, Patent opposition & licensing, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines staffing structure and specialist allocations the office uses to assign examinations and administrative duties; relevant for resourcing and process design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Technology Center structure and roles
rubrics_metrics.description: IT Center organization: Head of Information Technology Center; Hardware Group (Hardware Administrator: Server & PC), Software Group (Database Administrator, Web Editor & Designer), Network Group (Network Administrators); current IT staffing counts and task splits (hardware & OS personnel, software system personnel).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies IT governance and responsibilities necessary to implement/maintain patent automation and online services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent search portal entry points / UI elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to portal 'http://patentsearch.moc.go.th' with UI elements indicated: 'Search type' and 'Select Data Source'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Minimal required search features—the public search interface should allow selection of search types and data sources.
